how_to_apply: Download the application format (Annexure-I) from the official DMRC notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely in capital letters.
Enclose all required educational certificates, service certificates, last promotion order, copy of PPO, NOC, D&R and vigilance clearance (Annexure-II), and last 5 years' APARs.

Send the duly filled application form through Speed Post superscribing the name of the post prominently on the cover to: Additional General Manager/HR/P, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi.
Alternatively, email the scanned copy of the filled application form and all supporting documents to [email protected] indicating the advertisement number in the email subject.

faq.question: Q1. What is DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DMRC Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment notification issued by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation to fill 73 executive and non-executive posts in Architecture, Civil/Track, Signaling & Telecommunication, and Environment departments on deputation and PRCE basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 73 vacancies are available across Supervisor, Engineer, and Senior Engineer posts in various departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of duly filled applications through Speed Post or email is 04 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For deputation, the maximum age limit is 55 years. For Post Retirement Contractual Engagement (PRCE), the age limit is a minimum of 55 years and a maximum of 62 years as on 01/10/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for deputation candidates comprises a Personal Interview, while candidates on PRCE basis undergo a Personal Interview and a medical fitness examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I submit my application for DMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their completed application form through Speed Post to the DMRC address in New Delhi or email scanned copies to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Engagements are made on Deputation basis (normal tenure of 5 years extendable up to 7 years) or Post Retirement Contractual Engagement (PRCE) basis (initially for one year, extendable).

faq.question: Q9. What salary is offered on PRCE basis?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration ranges from Rs. 56,300/- to Rs. 96,600/- per month for Delhi office postings, and Rs. 61,900/- to Rs. 1,06,300/- per month for outstation office postings depending on the retired substantive grade.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose educational certificates, work experience certificates, last promotion order, copy of PPO, NOC from current employer, D&AR and vigilance clearance (Annexure-II), and APARs of the last 5 years.
